scalars.scalar_value: Experience handling, restraining & transporting large domestic animals.
Experience working with & handling large domestic farm animals in a veterinary clinic.
Work Monday-Friday 8-hour shifts, hours to be arranged with the possibility of overtime.

items.item_text: Current CA Class C driver’s license.
Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Experience working with & handling large domestic farm animals in a veterinary clinic.
Experience handling, restraining & transporting large domestic animals.
Experience with minor plumbing and mechanical repairs.

Want to be part of the most innovative veterinary team in the country? We are looking for a Large Animal Clinic Support Technician to work alongside our world leading faculty clinicians and technicians, helping them teach the next generation of veterinarians while also serving the animals and pet owners of our community.
As part of the top ranked UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital team, our technicians are provided with the following benefits:

Under Direction of the Large Animal Feed and Bedding Manager, order and maintain feed supply for multiple large animal species. Maintain patient stalls and holding areas. Transport large animal patients to various locations throughout the School of Veterinary Medicine complex. Provide patient care support to clinicians and technicians.
Knowledge of feeds and feeding to identify the different feeds and proportions for patients in a large animal clinic setting.
Skill to recognize & handle difficult/unpleasant situations & individuals.
Knowledge of horse movement protocols at the Center for Equine Health and the Gourley Center.
Skills to understand written instructions on patient care and basic care of large animals.
Skill in using a pitchfork, shovel, broom, gas powered vacuum and high-pressure water hose.
Skill to drive a truck, tractor & forklift, pull a train of dump carts of way wagons & back a single trailer.
